title: Data Architect
description:
**Your role**
-------------

**About us**
------------

Atlas Copco is a Swedish multinational industrial company that was founded in 1873 headquartered in Nacka, Sweden. We are world leaders in Compressors; we also manufacture industrial tools and equipment.


We are an IT Service Provider company within Atlas Copco Group called Global IT Hub (India). We are also focusing on Digital transformation Technologies for Data Driven Decisions, Web and Applications developments, Automations, IT Infrastructure etc.


Data Analytics Competence is the competence within the Global IT Hub (India).


**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Solution Architect to join our growing Data \& Aanlytics team from Digital Technology vertical. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing innovative data solutions that support our data analytics initiatives. You will bridge the gap between business needs and technical feasibility, ensuring our data infrastructure is scalable, secure, and optimized for advanced analytics.


### **The Role**

* **Bridges the gap:** Translates business needs into technical solutions for data analytics projects.
* **Designs the roadmap:** Define and implement scalable, secure data architectures for analytics platforms and BI solutions.
* **Technology expertise:** Possesses deep knowledge of various data technologies (cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, analytics tools) to recommend the best fit for optimal performance.
* **Integration champion:** Designs solutions that integrate seamlessly with existing IT infrastructure.
* **Scalability focus:** Keeps scalability and future growth in mind when designing the architecture.
* **Collaboration king:** Works closely with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and stakeholders to ensure everyone's on the same page.
* **Risk assessment:** Identifies potential risks and proposes solutions to mitigate them.
* **Communication is key:** Clearly communicates complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* **Innovation:** Stays at part with emerging trends in data and analytics to future\-proof solutions.

**Key responsibilities and accountabilities**
---------------------------------------------

### **Skills and Experience**

* **Data Modelling \& Design:** Expertise in data modelling techniques, including relational (SQL) and non\-relational (NoSQL) databases.
* **Data Warehousing \& ETL:** Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, and big data technologies.
* **Programming Languages:** Proficiency in SQL and potentially scripting languages like Python, Spark, etc. for data manipulation and automation.
* **Cloud Platforms:** Knowledge of cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, Data Bricks, Fabric) for deploying and managing data solutions.
* **Data Management \& Security:** Understanding of data governance, security best practices, and data access controls.
* Certifications: good to have relavent certifications which shows academic regor e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Databricks Certified Solution Architect

**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

### **Competences**

* **Communication \& Collaboration:** Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Critical Thinking:** Ability to analyze complex data problems and design effective solutions.
* **Project Management:** Experience managing data\-related projects and ensuring successful execution.
* **Teamwork:** Ability to guide \& collaborate effectively with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and business teams.
* **Strategic thinking** and E **nterprise\-level solution design**

### **Stakeholder management**

* You can discuss with stakeholders about their requirements and clearly communicate back your understanding of the requirements.
* You can work with the stakeholders to understand the big picture and work towards it.
* Work with team members and other users from the organization at different levels for performance improvement and suggestions.

### **Must have**

* Communication skills, Facilitation: Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between technical and non\-technical stakeholders (business users, data engineers, analysts, data scientists).
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a team environment, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing across the data team.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyse complex business needs and translate them into technical solutions for data analytics projects.
* Technical Architecture Design: Skilled at designing and implementing scalable data pipelines, platforms, and tools to support data analytics at an enterprise level.
* Technology Selection: Deep knowledge of various data technologies (cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, analytics tools) to recommend the best fit for specific needs.

### **Nice to have**

* Emerging Technologies: Curiosity and interest in keeping up with emerging data technologies.
* Experience in hybrid environments: cloud \+ on\-prem
* Business Acumen: Understanding of core business processes and how data analytics can drive strategic decision\-making.
* Project Management Tools: Experience with project management methodologies and tools like Agile or Scrum.
* Mentorship: Ability to mentor and guide junior team members within the data team.

### **Education**

* Any Graduate (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/MTech/BSc/MSc/MCS) in Engineering with 8\+ years of experience in software development/data analytics domain and at least 5 years of experience as a solution architect on IT Projects.

### **Knowledge**

* Good analytical skills: You feel comfortable working with numbers/data, e.g. collecting and analysing trend graphs, combining the info with insights from ERP and previous site visits to come to a sound conclusion.
* You are fluent in English: both written and spoken.

### **Personality requirements**

* You like open communication and enjoy working with different cultures.
* You are decisive (not afraid of making errors and willing to learn by doing)
* Open minded; expect the unexpected (\= stay sceptical when viewing at the data and info)
* Not afraid to approach other stakeholders (customer centre specialists, local engineering, or technical support specialists)
* You work with a structured approach when collecting info and data, but also when closing the feedback loop to further increase your learning.

**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

**What we offer**
-----------------

* This is a leadership role focused on defining roadmap of Data Engineering competence and achieving it.
* Global exposure and opportunities
* This role is ideal for you, if you wish to challenge yourself on Technological front and creating competence centre for Data Engineering and Visualization
* This role gives you enough opportunities to build your professional network among technical fraternity within the group.
* This role also expects you to build a very strong network of local ecosystem and bring the benefits for Atlas Copco
* Flexible working hours
* Flexible office and home working policies
* A modern infrastructure providing you with the latest tools and technologies at your disposal.
* A challenging environment which contributes to your constant learning and professional growth
* To be part of the data competence team which is constantly growing.
* Depending on the country you are enrolled in group healthcare insurance plans covering your medical needs.
* A chance to become part of a global, innovative company, supporting sustainable productivity.
* You get the opportunity to bring revolutionary ideas fostering innovation and execute qualified ideas.
* A friendly culture with immense professional and personal development, education, and opportunities for career growth
* Free access to LinkedIn Learning and many other internal and external trainings
* Atlas Copco offers trainings on a regular basis to acquire new skills.
* You get the opportunity to make the world a better place through our sustainable goals and by contributing and being part of our Water for all projects.
* Friendly and open culture of Swedish company. Very high visibility in the organization with "No door" culture, you can always talk to anyone in the organization.
* Free canteen and transport facility.

**Job location**
----------------

Hybrid
  

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on\-site at our Atlas Copco in Vadodara, India.

BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry\-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist with deep experience in B2B SaaS to lead the development of advanced analytics, predictive models, and AI\-driven insights that improve business performance and customer outcomes. This role will partner closely with teams across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Data teams to solve high\-impact business problems using data science.
The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, and business analytics, combined with a practical understanding of key SaaS metrics such as ARR, NRR, churn, retention, expansion, pipeline conversion, customer health, and product adoption. This person must be able to move fluently between technical depth and business context, translating complex data into actionable recommendations that influence strategy and execution.
Here is how, through this exciting role, YOU will contribute to BMC's and your own success:
* Develop and deploy predictive and prescriptive models to solve critical business problems across the B2B SaaS lifecycle.


* Build data science solutions for use cases such as customer churn prediction, upsell propensity, lead scoring, pipeline forecasting, product adoption, customer segmentation, pricing optimization, and customer health scoring.


* Partner with Sales, Operations, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to identify opportunities where data science can improve growth, retention, and operational efficiency.


* Design and analyze experiments, A/B tests, and quasi\-experimental studies to measure the impact of product, marketing, and sales initiatives.


* Apply statistical methods and machine learning techniques to large, complex datasets from CRM, product telemetry, marketing, support, finance, and customer systems.


* Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches and communicate findings clearly to executive and cross\-functional stakeholders.


* Collaborate with data engineers, analytics engineers, BI teams, and architects to ensure scalable data pipelines and production\-ready modeling workflows.


* Monitor model performance, validate assumptions, and continuously improve model accuracy, explainability, and business relevance.


* Support the development of self\-service insights, reusable data science assets, and scalable frameworks for decision\-making.


* Document methodologies, assumptions, and business impact in a clear and reproducible manner.


To ensure you’re set up for success, you will bring the following skillset \& experience:
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.


* 8\+ years of experience in data science \& machine learning, with significant experience in B2B SaaS environments.


* Strong expertise in machine learning, statistical modeling, forecasting, experimentation, and causal analysis.


* Strong proficiency in Python and advanced SQL skills.


* Experience working with large\-scale business, sales, and product datasets, including CRM, telemetry, subscription, and customer data.


* Deep understanding of B2B SaaS business models and core metrics such as ARR, MRR, churn, retention, expansion, NRR, CAC, LTV, conversion, and product usage/adoption.


* Hands\-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and modern AI frameworks such as OpenAI APIs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar tools.


* Familiarity with RAG, prompt engineering, model evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI practices for enterprise\-ready AI solutions.


* Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery


* Experience in subscription analytics, revenue analytics, product\-led growth, or customer lifecycle modeling.


* Experience building models that support GTM, Product, or Customer Success decision\-making.


* Strong ability to communicate technical findings to non\-technical audiences and influence business decisions.


* Experience working cross\-functionally in fast\-paced, matrixed environments.


* Familiarity with GenAI or AI\-enabled analytical workflows is a plus.


* Familiarity with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker

  

  

Core Skills:
* Machine Learning


* Statistical Modeling


* Forecasting


* Experimentation and A/B Testing


* Customer Churn and Retention Analytics


* Product Adoption Analytics


* Revenue and Growth Analytics


* Segmentation and Propensity Modeling


* Python


* SQL


* Applied AI / Generative AI


* Large Language Models (LLMs) / Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)


* Data Storytelling


* Cross\-Functional Business Partnership

  

  

What Success Looks Like:
Success in this role means delivering data science solutions that create measurable business impact. This includes improving customer retention, accelerating growth, increasing forecast accuracy, identifying high\-value opportunities, and enabling smarter decisions across the B2B SaaS customer lifecycle. The successful candidate will combine strong technical rigor with business judgment and will help embed data science into everyday decision\-making across the organization.
**Our commitment to you!**

  

BMC’s culture is built around its people. We have 6000\+ brilliant minds working together across the globe. You won’t be known just by your employee number, but for your true authentic self. BMC lets you be YOU!

  

  

If after reading the above, You’re unsure if you meet the qualifications of this role but are deeply excited about BMC and this team, we still encourage you to apply! We want to attract talents from diverse backgrounds and experience to ensure we face the world together with the best ideas!

  

BMC is committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, age, sex, creed, color, religion, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy, disabled veteran or status as a protected veteran. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, visit the accommodation request page.


BMC Software maintains a strict policy of not requesting any form of payment in exchange for employment opportunities, upholding a fair and ethical hiring process.

title: Senior Vice President - Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP)
description:
Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP), Pune


Senior Vice President


Pune, India


**About Infrastructure Technology**

The Global Infrastructure organization builds and maintains the critical technology backbone that enables Jefferies to operate at scale, delivering secure, resilient, and high\-performing IT services that power the business. We drive innovation through solutions such as cloud and hybrid adoption, network resiliency, platform modernization, and automation. The organization is structured into several specialized sub\-domains: Core Infrastructure Platform, Public Cloud, Digital Workspace, Networking, Telecom \& Multimedia, and International Infrastructure. Our teams collaborate globally to ensure Jefferies’ technology platforms are highly available, secure, scalable, and cost\-effective.


**Core Infrastructure Platforms**

The Core Infrastructure Platforms function lays the foundation for Jefferies’ IT, designing, operating, and optimizing the essential compute, storage, operating systems, and database platforms that support all business\-critical applications. Our mission is to deliver secure, resilient, and high\-performance datacenter and cloud solutions for global operations.


Organized into four teams, Global Systems Engineering, Unix Engineering, Windows Engineering, and Database Engineering, this group drives operational excellence, security, high availability, compliance, and continuous improvement across our technology estate.


By championing automation, standardization, and proactive monitoring, and by working closely with application, security, and business teams, we ensure our environments are robust, stable, and scalable. Through this collaborative approach and a relentless focus on modernization, Jefferies’ infrastructure remains agile and adaptable, ready to meet the evolving needs of our global business.


**Job Summary**

Jefferies is seeking a dynamic, hands\-on, and strategic Senior Vice President (SVP), Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (Pune). This executive technical leader will lead automation, operations, and modernization of Jefferies’ platform stack, with a focus on critical platform domains: databases, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, and Unix/Windows server infrastructure. Based in Pune, India, the SVP will lead the Pune CIP team and be accountable for technical excellence, operational resilience, and end\-to\-end Pune led delivery supporting the US, EMEA and APAC estate. This role reports to the Head of GCC, Pune (primary) and the Global Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms, Jersey City (secondary).


This is not a pure management or “middle\-layer” role. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on domain expert who remains technically current, acts as a trusted escalation point and decision\-maker, and independently resolves complex infrastructure and operational challenges rather than simply escalating them.


Success in this role comes from earning the trust of engineers and global business stakeholders through demonstrated technical mastery, incident command, and the delivery of solutions that enable strategic business outcomes. The position requires deep technical expertise paired with proven people leadership to build, mentor, and scale high\-performing teams supporting 24/7 capital markets operations.  



**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Platform Leadership:** partner with global leads on the vision, engineering standards, and operational governance for Jefferies’ core infrastructure stack: database, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, Unix/Linux, and Windows server platforms, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* **Local Management of the Infrastructure Team:** direct managerial responsibilities for Infrastructure Technology team members located in the Jefferies Pune office (Networks, Telecom, Digital Workplace, Cloud, CIP, Service Delivery).
* **Modernization \& Cloud/Hybrid Adoption:** Drive modernization, cloud/hybrid adoption, automation\-first delivery, and standardization across all domains, balancing operational excellence with innovation and optimization. Lead strategic integration and optimal workload placement between on\-premises and cloud resources, as business and regulatory requirements permit.
* **Hands\-on Technical Escalation:** Serve as the final point of escalation and technical incident lead during major outages, performance, or security incidents. Analyze real\-time symptoms, ask the right diagnostic questions, and guide teams towards root\-cause resolution.
* **Solution Delivery:** Architect and deliver practical, high\-impact solutions for business and application teams, actively collaborating with CIO leadership, BU leads, and local metro SVPs/VPs worldwide.
* **Operational Resilience** : Own and continuously improve resilience, high\-availability, recovery, and compliance strategies across the global platform estate.
* **Global Team Development:** Partner with global leads in NYC, London, and HK to cultivate a high\-performing, distributed team of engineers and architects, primarily based in India. You will mentor leaders and engineers, promote end\-to\-end ownership, and develop problem\-solving capability.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Partner with business units, application teams, and senior platform leaders to align technical priorities, communicate platform direction, and enable local\-global business outcomes.
* **Technical Standards \& Documentation:** Author, maintain, and enforce robust operational standards, SLAs, playbooks, and knowledge base for platform operations and incident response.
* **Post\-Incident Review \& Learning:** Lead technical post\-mortems and deep\-dives, drive remediation, and foster a culture of continuous technical learning.
* **Regulatory \& Risk Alignment:** Execute robust security, compliance, vulnerability management, and audit readiness for mission\-critical infrastructure in a highly regulated financial services environment.

**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:**
	+ 15\+ years in IT infrastructure/platform engineering and operations, with at least 5 years in global technical leadership (financial services or complex enterprise IT preferred).
	+ Proven recent, hands\-on experience with at least three of: database platforms (SQL/Oracle/etc), virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V/KVM, Nutanix), storage (SAN/NAS), backup/DR, Unix/Linux, and Windows server engineering and operations.
	+ Track record as a solution owner, not just a conduit, able to independently architect and deliver technical outcomes in critical environments.
* **Core Competencies:**
	+ Deep technical expertise, able to lead troubleshooting, ask the right questions, synthesize technical indicators, and command resolution during platform issues and outages.
	+ Domain credibility, regarded by engineers and senior IT partners as the go\-to technical escalation contact.
	+ Record of driving platform modernization, cloud/hybrid/cloud adoption, automation, and cost/risk optimization.
	+ Strong foundation in regulatory, compliance, and operational risk management for infrastructure.
	+ Executive presence, able to command trust in both technical and business forums, and partner with C\-levels, application owners, and metro engineering leaders.
	+ Outstanding stakeholder management, communication, prioritization, and conflict resolution skills, on both local (India) and global scales.
	+ Experience designing and enforcing technical standards, SLAs, and incident management frameworks.
* **Certifications (optional, but valued):**Recognized certifications (RHCE, MCSE, VMware, Nutanix, NetApp, AWS/Azure/GCP, ITIL, etc.)  

	+

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent required; Master’s degree preferred.  

* 

**What Success Looks Like**

The SVP delivers a world\-class platform that serves as a resilient, secure, continuously modernizing backbone for all Jefferies business applications, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You lead actively, commanding incidents, delivering solutions, and growing your team’s technical and operational capability. You are trusted by engineers as a technical authority, by CIO/BU leaders as a business partner, and by the enterprise as the leader who enables robust, scalable solutions tightly aligned with the business's needs.  



**Equal Opportunity Employer:** Jefferies values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
